summary: Seven base records satisfy the comp rules (R1958, R9866, R9548, R4440, R1583, R4318, R3508), plus R5005 which is a same-entity duplicate of R1958 and was deduplicated. Ranking qualified, deduplicated comps by distance ascending then most recent closing date yields the five selected: R1958 (0.80 mi, $400/sf), R9866 (1.03 mi, $432.56/sf), R9548 (1.26 mi, $400/sf), R4440 (1.49 mi, $400/sf) and R1583 (1.72 mi, $400/sf). R4318 (1.95 mi) and R3508 (2.18 mi) qualify but fall outside the five-comp cap. Precedence applied: executed amendment U-R9866-1 (2026-08-20) raised R9866 consideration to USD 11,160,000; the unsigned draft U-R4440-3 and the post-cutoff amendment U-R9548-2 (2026-09-10) were disregarded. Observed pricing clusters tightly at $400/sf, with R9866 the sole outlier at $432.56/sf after amendment. No comp-grid workbook or CSV was produced; artifact creation is outside this direct API control.
limitations: No workbook/CSV artifact was generated in this direct API run; the selected facts and citations are provided inline only.

Post-cutoff amendment U-R9548-2 would reduce R9548 consideration to USD 1 (implying ~$0.00004/sf); if that amendment is later deemed controlling, R9548 would likely fail the positive/market-consideration test and R4318 would move into the shortlist.
R6730 (4.71 mi, 29,400 sf, USD 11.76M) appears substantively comparable but was excluded solely because its evidence was published after the 2026-08-31 cutoff.
R5005 and R1958 report identical entity, date, size and price; the duplicate call relies on shared entity_id BIRCH-SAL-58018 and R5005's 'second_source_same_underlying_record' evidence kind.
R2037 may be an in-range retail sale, but the 'acre' size unit conflicts with a 31,200 figure and cannot be reconciled from the extracts; treated as wrong size unit rather than converted.
R7511 consideration is unknown, not zero; a later disclosed price could make it eligible (4.25 mi).
Distances are as reported in the extracts; no independent geocoding, sub-market, tenancy, lease-term, cap-rate or condition detail was available to refine comparability.
No buyer/seller, broker or contact information is evidenced in the packet, so none is asserted.
